Authorities Prepare for Chhath Puja Security and Lighting

Authorities are making arrangements for security and lighting at ghats for the Chhath Puja festival. In Ramnagar, the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) has instructed officials to ensure these arrangements. In Noida, approximately 1,000 police personnel will be deployed across 17 ghats and 40 other locations for the festival.
